summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest 16/16 passed) + frontend (Playwright) E2E testing of Fun Center. All critical flows pass: dev auth (dev123), CRUD with bearer token enforcement (401 on unauth), file upload incl. ffmpeg auto-thumbnail for videos, file serving, global search, navigation, password gate, blog creation visible on /blog, search filtering, and full video/music player controls (play/pause/prev/next/shuffle/autoplay/repeat/speed/mute/seek).

minor.issue: Returns 200 (not 201) for token creation - acceptable but non-RESTful
Dev tokens are stored in process memory; backend restart invalidates all tokens. Intentional per single-password design but worth noting.

issues: Marquee, hero, bento and color-block design renders well; no contrast/spacing issues detected.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~336 lines; well-organized, no split needed yet.
DRY: 4 list endpoints (apps/blogs/videos/music) share identical search-regex pattern. Could be extracted to a helper for maintainability (low priority).
Auth: in-memory ACTIVE_TOKENS set is intentional per spec (single password). Acceptable for current scope.

Security: /api/upload accepts any file extension within allowed folders. Consider validating MIME/extension server-side per folder (e.g. only images for thumbnails) to prevent abuse. Not blocking but recommended.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded in all queries via projection {'_id': 0}.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed items and clean them up after each test. E2E playwright test created blog/video/music/app items and cleaned them up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_funcenter_api.py covers auth, CRUD on all 4 resources, file upload with ffmpeg thumbnail (uses subprocess to generate a 2s test mp4), and search. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_funcenter_api.py -v. Frontend testids verified: nav-{home,apps,blog,videos,music,upload,logout}, search-input, dev-password-input, dev-login-btn, upload-gate, upload-dashboard, tab-{apps,blog,video,music}, blog-{title,author,url,desc,thumb,save-btn}, app-{title,category,version,desc,thumb,file,source-local,source-external,external-url,save-btn}, video-{title,category,desc,thumb,file,external-url,embed-code,source-local,source-external,source-embed,thumb-{id},play,prev,next,shuffle,autoplay,speed,mute,seek,save-btn}, music-{title,artist,genre,desc,thumb,file,external-url,embed-code,source-local,source-external,source-embed,row-{id},play,prev,next,shuffle,repeat,autoplay,speed,mute,seek,save-btn}. Note: Custom HTML5 video player renders only when a selected video has video_url (local or external); pure embed-code videos render iframe instead — this is correct/intentional. Music player renders sticky bottom player when music list is non-empty.
